description: Decision vs structure scorecard — prove unified brain axes

decision.query: why did we choose JWT over session cookies
why SQLite for the project brain
why 1500 token pack budget for agents
why hooks capture instead of manual remember

seed_neurons.title: JWT over sessions
seed_neurons.content: We chose JWT bearer tokens instead of session cookies for Edge compatibility.

seed_neurons.title: SQLite local brain
seed_neurons.content: Project brain stays in local SQLite FTS5 — no cloud vector DB by default.

seed_neurons.title: 1500 token budget
seed_neurons.content: Agent-facing packs are capped at 1500 tokens so injection stays lean.

seed_neurons.title: Hooks primary capture
seed_neurons.content: Hooks and auto_observe fill the brain; MCP remember is pin/correct only.
